Give each structural gate a case that fails when the gate narrows, in the gate's own file, next to the rule it guards. description:

Fix: on the zero-key path the agent never sees/handles receipt.challenge; citation is a passive metadata echo, not an action the agent performs; add an explicit declarative 'no action or payment is required from you' statement in the envelope; document the trust/payment model at /llms-full.txt section 4; keep paid-to-cite clearly distinct from pay-to-proceed. Acceptance / test fixture: capture Claude's verbatim refusal from the 2026-05-18 Screencast; protocol is 'fixed' when an unmodified Claude completes discover->query->cite with zero safety objection.
